assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with the neurological symptoms and dizziness.
The clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service.
The service at issue is CPT 93229.
The applicable diagnosis codes are I47.1, G45.9, and R42.
